title: Incident context harvester: adaptive trace sampling + PD annotator
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight "incident context harvester" that attaches a curated evidence bundle to PagerDuty alerts and Slack ops threads. The harvester will: (1) trigger on PD/Slack incident webhooks or manual 'collect context' button, (2) perform adaptive trace/sample collection (time-bound + fingerprinted selection) to capture representative spans, (3) include metric fingerprints and recent aggregated logs for the affected service, (4) attach a short synthesized summary plus links to full telemetry dashboards. Goal: reduce mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-restore by giving oncall engineers high-signal context without overloading PD/Slack or our storage with full traces. This ticket focuses on the integration surface, policy for sampling/retention, and the PagerDuty annotation payload format. Implementation will be staged: PoC -> canary in staging -> rollout with opt-in for teams.
acceptance_criteria: A webhook-based collector endpoint exists that accepts PD/Slack triggers and returns 202 within 500ms
Adaptive sampling policy implemented: time window + fingerprint selector that limits collected spans to <= 10 spans for infra-level incidents and <= 25 for customer-impacting incidents
PagerDuty events include an attachment with: 1-sentence synthesized summary, top 3 spans (span id + short reason), metric fingerprint (top 5 metrics + values), and links to Grafana panels
Slack message actions render a 'Collect context' button that calls the same collector and posts an ops-thread message with the evidence bundle
Collector respects team-level retention and KMS encryption settings and logs an audit event on every collection
comments: 2025-02-28 - Maya Chen: Kickoff notes: scoped to PD/Slack triggers only (no email). We will reuse the trace-sampler library from runtime. Priority on being lightweight and reversible. PRD link in attachments.

2025-03-02 - Luca Rossi: PoC running in staging. Adaptive sampler uses metric anomaly score + a time-proximity heuristic. Current PoC collects full trace for first 30s after trigger; this needs tuning to meet acceptance criteria.

2025-03-04 - Design feedback (Diego Alvarez): Suggested summary format with template variables: [service] [impact] [top span reasons] and include a truncated query of recent logs (<= 3 log snippets). Approved by PM for staging canary.

2025-03-05 - Luca Rossi: Implemented PD annotation payload and added audit events. Need security review for signed URLs; filing follow-up to security team. Added tests for 202 response and basic payload schema. Linking PR in attachments.

2025-03-05 - Maya Chen: Note: add telemetry counters for 'collections triggered', 'collections succeeded', 'collections rate-limited' to monitor rollouts. Add dashboards for these counters in console-2025.03 release.
next_steps: Finish PoC tuning: cap spans and enable signed URL behavior for full trace retrieval
Add rate-limiter and team opt-in flag in console settings
Request security review for signed URL expiration and KMS usage (follow-up ticket if needed)
Canary deploy to staging on 2025-03-10, monitor 'collections rate-limited' and storage costs for 2 weeks
risk: Medium: collecting telemetry on PD/Slack triggers increases storage and operational surface area. Mitigations: signed URLs for full traces, strict adaptive sampling caps, rate-limiter, and opt-in per-team. Potential privacy risk if logs include PII—must honor tenant redaction and retention settings.
design_decisions: Use adaptive sampler based on metric fingerprint + recency rather than full-trace sampling by default
Attach synthesized 1-line summary and top span excerpts instead of full traces in PD/Slack to keep payloads small
Store any full-trace artifacts behind signed URLs that expire in 24 hours; default revoke window configurable per-team
Reuse existing trace-sampler library from runtime team to avoid duplicating kernel logic
implementation_notes: Collector endpoint implemented as /v1/incident/context-collect accepting a PD/Slack webhook idempotency key
Sampler adapts by computing a 'relevance score' from metric anomalies, span error rates, and request frequency
Audit events emitted to internal event-bus with topic 'incident.harvester.audit'
Encryption: use customer KMS key when team has private deployment; otherwise use platform default KMS
Respect SLOs: collector must not block or delay PD ack — respond 202 then stream collection async
test_plan: Unit tests for sampler: deterministic selection given seeded trace+metric patterns
Integration test: PD webhook triggers produce expected PD annotation payload in staging (verify fields and signed URL behavior)
Load test: simulate 100 alerts/min and assert collector rate-limits and 202 latency budget met
E2E: Slack button flow posts message in ops thread and links to dashboard panels
